charts.description: The data-only chart API is compiled into the standalone browser bundle; charts do not require the desktop host.

privileged-base.description: Prerequisite for privileged operations. Each concrete operation still needs its own grant and implemented web adapter; this grants no container filesystem access.

persistent-storage.description: Original contract memory, JSON and custom store lifecycle. Mount /data for persistence; one replica owns each store.

encrypted-secrets.description: AES-256-GCM credential vault. Inject WEB_APP_SECRET_KEY and mount /data; desktop credentials are never copied.

network.description: Backend network operations retain transport and destination grants. Configure cloud egress for private destinations.

raw-network.description: Backend TCP, UDP and DNS use the exported transport and destination policy. Configure deployment egress for remote networks.

clipboard.description: Browser Clipboard API; HTTPS, browser permission and a user gesture are required.

ssh.description: Standalone SSH service with encrypted credentials, enrolled profiles and pinned host fingerprints. Configure deployment/services.json; no desktop sessions are copied.

ssh-streaming.description: Standalone SSH status and execution streams retain cancellation and output limits.

ssh-terminal.description: Standalone terminal service retains quotas and browser view leases. Remote profiles and credentials require deployment configuration.

x11.description: Configure a display gateway with explicit X11 authorization. Containers do not create a desktop display automatically.

filesystem.description: Scoped filesystem operations run against deployment volumes. Configure pathMappings for desktop roots; mutations retain confirmation and scope checks.

process.description: Scoped commands execute in the container with original executable/argument policies and confirmation. Azure CLI and Git tooling are included when required; install other tools in Dockerfile and map their paths.

ai.description: Configure a standalone service gateway for the AI protocol. Requests retain AI capability checks; desktop provider credentials are not copied.

tray.description: Tray actions are exposed as a browser action menu. Background execution belongs to the backend service.

elevation.description: Configure an HTTPS service gateway for approved elevated operations. The container remains unprivileged and browser approval is required.

authentication.description: Configure an independent authentication/session service gateway with deployment callback URLs. Desktop login sessions are not reused.

browser.description: Open validated HTTP/HTTPS links in the user's browser.
